_comment: Copy to github.config.json (gitignored). Token needs 'repo' scope (classic PAT) or fine-grained with Actions: Read. Get one at https://github.com/settings/tokens. The daemon will list your most-recently-pushed repos and fetch the latest workflow run for each.
_affiliation_comment: Comma-list: owner, collaborator, organization_member. Default covers all three.
_maxRepos_comment: How many recently-pushed repos to scan each refresh. Each repo = 1 extra API call, so keep modest.
